user.title: Create Notification Catalog
user.description: A catalog sends all of its notification rules to one fixed set of Inovelli devices.

targets.title: Choose Notification Lights
targets.description: Choose one or more Zigbee2MQTT groups to combine their memberships and use native Zigbee groupcasts, or choose individual Inovelli devices. Each group's exact MQTT friendly name is read directly from Zigbee2MQTT.

init.title: Notify Lights
init.description: The notification lights answer **where** a notification appears. Notification rules answer **when** it appears. What each one looks like is set on its own light, in this device's configuration section.

edit_targets.title: Edit Notification Lights
edit_targets.description: Choose one or more Zigbee2MQTT groups to combine their memberships and use native Zigbee groupcasts, or choose individual Inovelli devices. Each group's exact MQTT friendly name is read directly from Zigbee2MQTT.

add_notification.title: Add Notification Rule
add_notification.description: Choose a plain-language activation behavior. Automatic rules can follow a state for as long as it is true, or start a timed notification when that state is entered. Color, brightness, and effect are set afterward on the rule's own light.

modify_notification_form.title: Edit Notification Rule
modify_notification_form.description: Renaming changes the display name only; the entity ID remains stable. Color, brightness, and effect live on the rule's own light, not here.

notification_source.title: Choose the State Source
notification_source.description: Select the Home Assistant entity that represents this condition. Next you'll choose its main state or a specific attribute, such as a climate entity's hvac_action.

notification_property.title: Choose What to Watch
notification_property.description: Watch the entity's main state, or choose one of its attributes. Current values are shown to make the choice understandable without looking in Developer Tools.

notification_details.title: Priority and Coverage
notification_details.description: Higher-priority notifications win when several are active on the same switch. Priority also orders these rules in the device's configuration section. Priority 30 or lower always has a one-pixel footprint in the stack, regardless of the selected coverage. Color, brightness, and effect are set on the rule's light once it exists.

error.name_exists: A record with this name already exists.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name containing at least one letter or number.
error.target_required: Choose a Zigbee2MQTT group or at least one Inovelli device.
error.group_or_devices: Choose Zigbee2MQTT groups or individual Inovelli devices, but do not mix the two.
error.z2m_registry_unavailable: Could not read Zigbee2MQTT's group registry. Check that MQTT and Zigbee2MQTT are available, then try again.
error.z2m_group_not_found: That group is not present in Zigbee2MQTT's current group registry.
